name: Ma'n ibn Aws
bio: Ma'n, of the tribe of Muzayna, lived through the coming of Islam and wrote praise poems for several Companions of the Prophet. He travelled to Syria and Basra and found generous hosts in Abd Allah ibn Abbas and Abd Allah ibn Ja'far. Abu Tammam selected verses of his on how far a friend can ask another to bear an injury. Al-Zirikli records that he lost his sight late in life and died in Medina in 64 AH (683 CE).
